# INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/information-schema-datasets-schemata-options
#
# Each script creates the dataset unverified_options_eu, which stays in the project after the
# scripts run.

# Whether the location of a dataset outside the US is in lower case too, as for the US.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_options_eu OPTIONS (location = 'EU');
SELECT option_value FROM `region-eu`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS WHERE schema_name = 'unverified_options_eu' AND option_name = 'location'
?>
